seo.title: DevCoveragePlansEngine · SEO Coverage
seo.lead: This hub documents the development process of each P2L white label. SEO Coverage Engine is a packaged product (tenant, login, ePayco plans, dashboard) with implementation plans in a PDF-style viewer.

wpf.title: DevCoveragePlansEngine · WPF Dashboard
wpf.lead: P2L Desktop web panel: free install guide, one ePayco card “AvlMonitor download”, and ZIP only after payment. This hub documents the dynamics; it does not deliver the archive.

more.title: More white labels in DevCoveragePlansEngine
more.lead: Other white labels will land here with their own plan folders (same scheme: PDF index + phase markdown). One GitHub Pages repo to see the full development timeline.

indigo.title: DevCoveragePlansEngine · RPA IndiGO
indigo.lead: Feasibility analysis, architecture, and a two-phase plan to evolve the IndiGO RPA into a supervised AI agent, with a front-herinco dashboard and central telemetry.

seo.benefits_title: SEO Coverage Engine is white label
seo.benefits_lead: Not just a module: a P2L product with its own tenant (p2l-seo-coverage), dedicated login, ES/EN i18n, ePayco plans, and an SEO audit dashboard.
seo.b1_text: API key, /login/seo-coverage-dashboard routes, and post-login to Coverage Score. Same BAAS platform, separate commercial identity.
seo.b2_text: Free → Plan 1/2/3 with audit credits, COP/USD pricing, and ePayco checkout scoped to the SEO tenant.
seo.b3_text: Implementation plans (Phase 1, 2–3, i18n/ePayco, vision) live in gh-pages-seo-coverage with a Markdown → PDF viewer.
seo.process_title: What you'll find in the plans
seo.process_lead: Open the viewer to read each plan as an engineering document: scope, deliverables, and how it was implemented.
seo.p1_text: Domain, crawl, analyzers, aggregated score, and per-URL findings.
seo.p2_text: GSC CSV import, coverage diff, gpt-4o-mini agent, quotas, and tasks.
seo.p3_text: ES/EN locales, plan packs, mobile-first accordions, and per-audit PDF.
seo.cta_text: Enter the Markdown viewer in PDF-style layout. That is the plan history for the SEO Coverage Engine white label.

wpf.benefits_lead: P2L Desktop product (tenant p2l-wpf): admins manage licenses and payments on the web; AVL monitoring runs in the .NET WPF client with Waze and local SQL Server.
wpf.b2_text: 5-day trial, Starter/Growth/Business/Enterprise, COP balance, and checkout scoped to the WPF tenant.
wpf.b3_text: One-shot company key, P2L_COMPANY_ID, and .env template for AvlMonitor (Google + companyId/key).
wpf.process_lead: Plans document the Vue dashboard flow and how it couples to the .NET client.
wpf.p1_text: Google admin, create company, key, Gmail drivers, and daily quotas.
wpf.p2_text: Plan top-up, cost per trip, and reactivation after the trial ends.
wpf.p3_text: .env gate, license validation, and Waze map on local SQL Server.
wpf.install_title: Desktop app, free guide, digital product
wpf.install_lead: AVL runs on Windows (.NET client). The install guide is free; the AvlMonitor ZIP is only downloadable from the web dashboard after ePayco — never from this hub.
wpf.install_b1_text: GUIA_INSTALACION.md: Windows, .NET 8, WebView2, SQL Server, .env, start-dev. Visible here in the viewer and free on /dashboard-wpf.
wpf.install_b2_text: In CompanyWpfDashboardView the only ePayco product is “AvlMonitor download”. After payment, AvlMonitor.zip unlocks via the authenticated p2l-wpf API.
wpf.install_b3_title: This hub does not serve the ZIP
wpf.install_b3_text: DevCoveragePlansEngine only documents dynamics and development coverage. The archive lives on the backend (modelos_back/assets/p2l-wpf) and downloads only for a paid company.
wpf.install_cta_text: Read GUIA_INSTALACION.md in the viewer. To buy/download the ZIP use the WPF product login, not this site.
wpf.cta_text: Development plans + install guide. The AvlMonitor ZIP is not published here: it is a digital product of the dashboard after ePayco.

more.benefits_lead: Each new white label adds a hero button and a sibling folder with its PDF index + *.plan.md. DevCoveragePlansEngine is the coverage index.
more.b1_text: Copy the gh-pages-seo-coverage or gh-pages-wpf-dashboard-coverage scheme: viewer index.html + phase markdown.
more.b2_text: Add a hero mode (like SEO Coverage / WPF Dashboard) that explains the white label and links to its PDF folder.
more.b3_text: DevCoveragePlansEngine index sits at the gh-pages root; each white label in its subfolder.
more.cta_text: When you add Tuki, Job Copilot, or others, they appear here with the same emphasis: white-label product + development process in PDF.

footer.blurb: DevCoveragePlansEngine — coverage of P2L white-label development. Plans in PDF/Markdown for GitHub Pages.

indigo.benefits_lead: Analysis, architecture, and a two-phase plan: front-herinco dashboard + Spring telemetry to 9 Windows machines. AI acts as a policy-gated copilot.
indigo.b1_text: AI proposes structured actions; a policy engine and humans validate before desktop clicks or commands.
indigo.b2_text: Each PC pushes telemetry; STOMP/SockJS realtime lives on the central back (no Socket.IO on each machine).
indigo.b3_text: Markdown → PDF in gh-pages-rpa-indigo-coverage with canvases, executive PDFs, and Phase 1 evidence.
indigo.process_lead: Open the viewer for the evolution report and the IndiGO RPA dashboard plan.
indigo.p1_text: Fleet/KPI UI, Sabelotodo-style AI usage, STOMP mock, and RPA telemetry hooks (flag off).
indigo.p2_text: HTTP ingest MSA, STOMP broker, 1-machine pilot with real AI; expand to nine PCs.
indigo.p3_text: Executive/architecture perspectives, draw.io diagrams, and Phase 1 execution captures.
indigo.cta_text: Enter the Markdown → PDF viewer with the report, Phase 1–2 plan, and assets index.
